answer_1.quote: SeeRee generates natural language responses to the task performer's inquiries based on the task and environment information ... SeeRee ... generates natural language responses in an auto-regressive way.
answer_1.outputs: natural language responses to navigation inquiries

answer_2.quote: we also evaluate the ablated models with language generation metrics, BLUE2 and ROUGE-L ... Primary metrics for task completion from each dataset: Goal Progress (GP), Success Rate (SR), Success weighted by inverse Path Length (SPL).

answer_4.quote: Human participants act as task performers ... We evaluate both settings where the helper agent exists or not. Human participants are also asked to rate the naturalness and faithfulness of the response from the helper.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the response on naturalness and faithfulness.
